propositions: Plan review LLM spend is dominated by re-runs (71% of 66,000 calls across 779 tickets) and can be reduced through reuse paths, pre-LLM short-circuits, cache efficiency, and criterion gating without weakening gate outcomes.
All 17 planned child changes plus 1 regression fix must land through Gerrit with LLM-Review and Verified approvals, including instrumentation, routing updates, and criterion blocking enablement.
Plan-review coverage metrics must report per-call token counts (input/output/cache) after Pass-1 instrumentation lands to validate token reduction claims.

Gate weakening prevention requires operator-approved thresholds for blocking criteria (T3, T10, T5c HIGH, G7) and confirmation that all previously blocking criteria remain blocking via criteria_routing.json diff review.
